fusions.name: Arm Over Arm
fusions.desc: Reaches out to 6 tiles to grab and yank one enemy, dealing 7 damage that grows the further it reaches, up to 1.6 times at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Every Limb at Once
fusions.desc: Grabs at everything within 3 tiles with every limb you have, dealing 14 damage to each enemy and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ceiling Crawl
fusions.desc: Climbs along the ceiling unseen and drops to a point up to 6 tiles away. You have 10% more dodge chance afterwards.

fusions.name: Spare Arm
fusions.desc: When you strike, a spare arm swats the nearest enemy within 4 tiles for 4 damage. Once every 3 seconds.
